parameters.name: electrode_pitch
parameters.justification: Centre distance between opposite electrodes; the alternating pattern has period 2*pitch, so the dominant Fourier mode decays as exp(-pi*y/pitch)

parameters.name: applied_voltage_amplitude
parameters.justification: Amplitude of the fundamental potential mode at the electrode plane (after the double-layer drop)

parameters.name: domain_height
parameters.justification: Two pitches: the mode has decayed to exp(-2*pi) = 0.2 % at the top

parameters.name: settlement_height_normalized
parameters.justification: 100 um above the surface, the height at which cyprid antennules and diatoms probe the surface
